summary: Preserve fresh KVMD snapshots under an authenticated temporary stream WebSocket lease and decode generated binary-response envelopes into JPEG bytes before OCR.
reason: This KVMD returns HTTP 503 for snapshots when no stream WebSocket is held open. OCR evidence must remain live, read-only, and byte-grounded rather than fail after transport wrapping or use a fabricated fallback.
validated_outcome: A TLS httptest fixture proves a 503 snapshot is retried under a token-authenticated stream lease and returns decoded JPEG bytes. A live read-only GLKVM observe invocation returned a fresh SHA-256 observation, dimensions, and OCR regions without HID, streamer configuration, reboot, or BIOS mutation.
